- [USER] The user expressed surprise at the influence of traditional African music on contemporary genres around the world.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable examples of traditional African music include:
  - West African Griot music, which has influenced Afrobeat and Highlife.
  - South African Mbube music, impacting Doo-wop and Gospel.
  - East African Taarab music, influencing Bongo Flava and Nairobian music.
  - Nigerian Juju music, which has influenced Afrobeat and Fuji.
  - Congolese Rumba music, impacting salsa and other Latin dance styles.
- [USER] The user requested more information on how Congolese rumba music has specifically impacted Latin American music.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Congolese rumba music significantly impacted Latin American music in the 1960s and 70s, with musicians like Tabu Ley Rochereau and Franco Luambo Makiadi gaining fame. Soukous rhythms influenced Caribbean styles like zouk and compas, and salsa music, particularly "salsa dura."
